evidence_plan.requirement: Inspect model to see if it learned to associate image parts with words related to entities

payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the model uses a modality attention module to learn associations between visual contexts and textual entities, suggesting inspection of learned associations.

claims.text: The model uses a modality attention module to amplify relevant visual contexts for disambiguating entities.
The modality attention module learns a unified representation that aggregates knowledge from multiple modalities, including images and words.
